items.question: What WNBA teams did Tina Thompson play for?
items.answer: Tina Thompson played 17 WNBA seasons: 12 with the Houston Comets (1997 to 2008), who made her, out of USC, the first pick of the first WNBA Draft, three with her hometown Los Angeles Sparks (2009 to 2011) and two with the Seattle Storm (2012 and 2013).

items.question: How tall is Tina Thompson?
items.answer: The WNBA lists Tina Thompson at 6 feet 2 inches and 178 pounds.

items.question: What are Tina Thompson's stats?
items.answer: In the 2013 regular season, Tina Thompson averaged 14.1 points, 5.8 rebounds, and 1.1 assists in 34 games for the Seattle Storm.

items.question: Did Tina Thompson coach Virginia?
items.answer: Yes. Virginia named Tina Thompson its women's basketball head coach on April 16, 2018. The school dismissed her in March 2022 after four seasons and a 30-63 record.

items.question: Is Tina Thompson in the Hall of Fame?
items.answer: Yes. Tina Thompson entered the Naismith Basketball Hall of Fame in 2018. She won the first four WNBA championships with Houston (1997 to 2000), retired as the league's career scoring leader with 7,488 points, made nine All-Star Games and won Olympic gold in 2004 and 2008.
